ratings.note: v-bottom.png: footer line with the desk phone number sits under the bar at the end of the page; only phone users who scroll to the end meet it; the number is the only contact route shown. s=2.
Zero-match search leaves the unrelated full list with no message; occasional (searches for tools not held), misleading about stock, recurs on every such search. s=3.
320 capture is wider than the viewport (sideways scroll); only small phones or high desktop zoom; annoyance that recurs every visit at that width. s=2.
Bar overlaps the instruction on load on many phones; pressing Reserve early gives a clear inline error, so a short detour; learned after once. s=2.
320 capture: both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, c...'; common on phones for variant tools; costs opening each card to tell them apart and is never overcome. s=3.
Only on an accidental Remove; loses the hold and the choices, several steps to rebuild and the one-off tool could go; not recurring once careful. s=2.
Icon-only filter button (375 capture) hides the date filter for top task 3; workaround is reading each card's date badge; once found it is remembered. s=2.
Identical wrench tiles on every card; names carry identification, so the effect is appearance only. s=1.

320/375 captures: search after all ten cards on phones; every phone visit, but with a ten-item catalogue scanning the list reaches the tool. s=3; rated 2 because browsing fully substitutes for search at this catalogue size.
Every reservation passes both buttons with 1.2-1.5 s of no visible change; annoyance and doubt, and a repeat tap on Confirm creates a second reference (B-011). s=3.

'+44 7700 900123' and lower-case membership numbers rejected with the same text as an empty field, so the member cannot see what is wrong; common formats; repeats each retry until format guessed. s=3.
Every reservation; only a 5 s toast with no link and an off-screen basket count, so a first-timer may stop thinking the tool is reserved; the toast word 'basket' mitigates some; learned once. s=3.
filters-open 1280: Category label sits lower than Available from; purely visual, labels still read correctly. s=1.
Same placeholder wrench tiles as B-061; appearance only, names identify tools. s=1.
Search and filters below the list on every phone visit; long scroll, but the ten cards with date badges let members answer top tasks by scanning. s=3; rated 2 for that alternative route.
Basket 1280 capture shows bare ground under the footer; desktop only, cosmetic. s=1.
Every completed reservation: reference number unemphasised and stale Basket (1); a minor search for the number; one-time per booking. s=2.
Every completed reservation leaves Basket (1) and the basket still lists the drill (probes 43/51); doubt and a plausible duplicate booking; persists until cleared by hand. s=3.
Confirm shows 'pick up Saturday 17 October' and a different session; always in the core change-session journey; may send a member on the wrong day. s=3.
320 capture: nav labels wrap to two lines; still legible and usable. s=1.
Desktop-only empty right half on confirm/done; no task effect. s=1.
Closed days (5 of 7) are selectable and only rejected after details are typed on the last step; first-timers do not know session days; significant rework. s=3.
Bar crosses the calendar in the first viewport on many screen sizes; scrolling reveals it; looks broken but recoverable. s=2.
probes/47: focused and selected day fully under the bar (2.4.11); keyboard users only; they lose sight of focus in the key step, partial cue from the 'Pick-up day' text. s=3.
Only on a repeat press within 1.5 s, made likelier by the missing pending state; two reservation numbers for one booking cause confusion at the desk. s=3.
probes/29: 22 Tabs to Reserve; keyboard-only users; extra effort every tool page. s=2.
probes/6/36: zero-match search leaves old cards and old status; occasional searches; misleads about stock and nothing announced to screen readers. s=3.
probes/65: dots vanish under forced colours on phones; rare setting, but those users cannot see session days and may pick a closed day every time. s=3.
Dark mode is common; available-now chips lose their fill so emphasis inverts; mild scanning cost. s=2.
probes/45/32: bar covers the second loan option and the footer line on phones; scrolling or choosing reveals the option in most cases. s=2.
filters-open capture: native select chevron vs themed elsewhere; cosmetic. s=1.
Every reservation passes the 'Reserve this tool' label though it only adds to a basket; first-timers may stop early; learned once. s=3.
Primary button and status outside landmarks; affects screen-reader users navigating by landmark; findable by other navigation. s=2.
probes/18/30/43: no change for about a second after both primary buttons, every reservation; doubt and repeat taps. s=3.
probes/2: both drill cards truncate identically on phones (main device); must open cards to tell them apart, every visit. s=3.
Same truncation at 375 as B-016; distinguishing words hidden on the main device every visit. s=3.
Basket 1280 capture shows newest-first visual order while focus starts at Sat 10 and arrows run backwards; keyboard/magnifier users in the critical step; wrong pick recoverable on confirm. s=3.
Two value-column offsets in the details list; cosmetic. s=1.
Same ragged columns as B-048; cosmetic. s=1.
Basket 1280 capture: sessions listed Wed 28 down to Sat 10 every reservation; labels are full dates so it is a scanning cost, understood once seen. s=2.
Badge text about 3.1:1 in dark mode (1.4.3 fail); dark mode and older members common; harder reading on every visit. s=3.
probes/53: stale error after emptying the basket; rare sequence; confusing but nothing left to do. s=1.
probes/60/61: Esc does not close and Tab cycles within the options; keyboard users must discover that choosing an option is the only exit. s=3.
Only members reserving four or more tools; being turned away at the desk for some tools is a real error. s=2.
Done aria lists the tool name twice; screen-reader users may think two tools were reserved; resolvable from context. s=2.
Same behaviour as B-001 (no Escape, no outside close, Tab stays in list); keyboard users on every tool page that open it. s=3.
Nav labels wrap at phone widths; legible. s=1.
Line break after 'FT-' in the error hint; the format is still readable. s=1.
probes/21: membership, name and phone cleared after Change; retyping three fields on a phone. s=2.
probes/5: sander reserved for a day before it is back, confirmed; occasional; the member makes a wasted trip or needs the desk. s=3.
Closed-day error has no link and the basket has no day control; recovery means going back to the tool page and re-reserving, so abandonment likely. s=3.
probes/1: search 2.5 screens down on every phone visit; s=3; rated 2 because browsing ten cards is a full alternative route at this catalogue size.
probes/42: hint says 'on or after' but later tools are dropped; misleads users of the date filter; not blocking. s=2.
Basket 1280: one wide card above five cramped wrapping cards in reverse order; scanning cost, understood once. s=2.
Every reservation: day already chosen, session unselected, Continue errors; extra decision for older members and the source of B-028 mismatches. s=3.
probes/3/14: Monday 12 October accepted into the basket, rejected only at confirm; common for first-timers. s=3.
Card headings at same level as the section heading; screen-reader heading navigation flattened; minor cost. s=2.
Same dark-mode chip inconsistency as B-051; common dark-mode use; blurs available-now vs later. s=2.
Basket 1280 capture: full-width first card, five cards wrapping to three lines; scanning cost. s=2.
Generic visual identity; no effect on task completion. s=1.
10-minute hold never stated (2.2.1); context says members reserve a few minutes at a time while doing other things, so expiry is common; expiry blocks completion (see B-013). s=4.
Same 375 truncation as B-016; drills indistinguishable on the main device. s=3.
Desktop-only mixed widths on confirm/done; cosmetic. s=1.
Expired hold gives 'Something went wrong. Try again.' and every retry fails the same way; reservation cannot be completed in that session. s=4.
probes/50/41: Change opens the basket with no session checked; core change-session journey; recall needed. s=2.
Generic identity, as B-062; appearance only. s=1.
Button announced as 'One week' without 'Loan length'; screen-reader users; resolvable from surrounding region. s=2.
Search below ten cards on phones every visit; s=3; rated 2 because scanning the short list is a full alternative.
Misaligned filter labels; cosmetic. s=1.
v-bottom.png: dots with the explanation in the paragraph directly above the calendar; every phone reservation, small effort, learned once. s=2.
